title: Fluence Faucet
tagline: 212 / 5,000 A faucet for Fluence developers. Log in with your Metamask wallet and receive your first FLT & tUSDC to interact with the testnet network.

prizes.placement: Best Contributions To Improving The Fluence Marketplace
prizes.title: Best Contributions To Improving The Fluence Marketplace

description:
Fluence Faucet brings a modern user interface and compatibility with a greater number of wallets. By signing with Ethereum wallets, developers can easily obtain FLT and tUSD tokens on the Fluence testnet.

Note: the transaction UI is, currently, a merely demonstrative. The initial goal of this project is to bring a new authentication mechanism with SIWE (Sign In With Ethereum) for Fluence Faucet.
how_its_made:
The project was built with HTML, JS, TailwindCSS and Webpack.

And it connect users wallet using Web3 Modal, SIWE and Ethers.js

The bundle is lightweight and all the code works client-side, making it possible to host it on any server and even on P2P networks such as IPFS. The idea is in the next step to use a cloudless backend powered by Fluence Network.

Currently the main quality of the project is UI
